theme: Control of DNA replication initiation and replication-stress checkpoints
core_role: The shared pathways are the core S-phase replication program (origin firing, E2F-driven licensing, and ATR-mediated replication checkpoint control), framed here as replication under surveillance that links to intra-S damage checkpoints and resolution of recombination intermediates.

theme: Hormonal and nutrient GPCR control of pancreatic islet secretion
core_role: The shared pathways are the incretin, glucagon, fatty-acid, cholinergic and somatostatin receptor inputs that tune insulin and glucagon release, framed as the GPCR signalling layer modulating beta-cell glucose-stimulated insulin secretion.

theme: APC/C-mediated degradation controlling mitotic exit
core_role: The shared pathways are APC/C:Cdc20 activity and its regulation that destroy cyclins, securin and Nek2A, framed as the early-anaphase engine of mitotic exit that hands off to APC/C:Cdh1 in late mitosis.

theme: Kidney nephron development and nephrogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe nephron formation from intermediate mesoderm through renal vesicle, comma- and S-shaped bodies to patterned tubules, framed as the morphogenetic sequence driven by metanephric mesenchyme-to-epithelium conversion and progenitor maintenance.

theme: Cardiac morphogenesis: chambers, myocardium and valves
core_role: The shared pathways cover development of heart chamber walls, trabecular/compact myocardium, endocardium, coronary vessels and semilunar valves, framed within heart morphogenesis that also includes endocardial-cushion EMT, septation and atrioventricular valve formation.

theme: TCA cycle and succinate dehydrogenase-linked oxidative phosphorylation
core_role: The shared pathways are the TCA cycle steps (succinate, malate) and complex II electron transfer feeding ATP synthesis, framed as mitochondrial energy metabolism whose enzymes depend on iron-sulfur cluster assembly and maturation.

theme: Inflammasome-driven pyroptosis in antibacterial defence
core_role: The shared pathways are AIM2/IPAF inflammasome assembly, bacterial detection and pyroptotic cell death (and its bacterial antagonism), framed as canonical inflammasome host defence alongside the non-canonical CASP4/5 and GBP-mediated pyroptotic pathways.

theme: p53-mediated DNA damage response and cell cycle arrest
core_role: The shared pathways are p53 stabilisation/activation after radiation damage and the G1 and G2/M checkpoint arrest it enforces, framed as the cell-cycle-arrest arm of the p53 response, with apoptosis and p53 regulation as the complementary outcomes.

theme: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair pathway choice
core_role: The shared pathways are DSB sensing by ATM and the end-joining repair routes plus regulation of the HR-versus-NHEJ choice, framed as the central DSB repair system that also extends to alternative routes like SSA and MMEJ.

theme: Type 2 (Th2) immunity: IL-4, IL-5, IL-13, IL-33
core_role: The shared pathways are Th2 differentiation and the production and signalling of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 and IL-33, framed as the cytokine core of type 2/allergic immunity leading to mast cell activation and IgE class switching.

theme: tRNA charging, modification and translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation together with tRNA modification and splicing, framed as maintenance of accurate decoding, alongside other translational fidelity mechanisms like selenocysteine incorporation and diphthamide.

theme: Selective autophagy and autophagosome formation regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are autophagosome assembly and maturation control plus selective cargo autophagy (pexophagy, mitophagy, ER-phagy, nucleophagy), framed as the machinery of selective autophagic degradation including xenophagy and vacuolar targeting.

theme: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and DNA replication licensing
core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F transcriptional program and G1/S genes that drive replication initiation, framed as the transcriptional control of origin licensing and pre-replicative complex assembly and activation.

theme: Nitrogen and ammonia disposal via the urea cycle
core_role: The shared pathways are aspartate, glutamine, arginine and citrulline metabolism and ammonium homeostasis, framed as the nitrogen-handling inputs and intermediates of the urea cycle, whose ornithine transport defects cause hyperammonemia.

theme: Leukotriene and lipoxin eicosanoid synthesis and signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are lipoxygenase-derived arachidonate metabolism producing leukotrienes, lipoxins and HETEs, framed as the lipid-mediator synthesis side of inflammatory signalling that acts through leukotriene receptors.

theme: p53-induced intrinsic apoptosis
core_role: The shared pathways are p53 transcriptional induction of pro-apoptotic genes (PUMA, caspases, death receptors, cytochrome c release) and its regulation, framed as the apoptotic arm of the p53 response alongside p21-mediated arrest and p53 control.

theme: cAMP second-messenger signalling via adenylate cyclase and PKA
core_role: The shared pathways are cAMP production and PKA activation downstream of GPCRs, framed as the cyclic-nucleotide signalling cascade that leads to CREB phosphorylation and neuronal and dopaminergic responses.

theme: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism from intestinal absorption to clearance
core_role: The shared pathways are lipoprotein lipase-mediated remodelling and clearance of chylomicrons and VLDL, framed as the circulating processing stage of dietary and hepatic lipid transport following intestinal absorption and lipoprotein assembly.

theme: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral type I interferon response
core_role: The shared pathways are RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of viral RNA and its TRAF-mediated NF-kB/IRF signalling and regulation, framed as cytosolic antiviral sensing that drives IRF3/7-dependent type I interferon production and ISG responses.

theme: Stress- and UV-induced cellular senescence
core_role: The shared pathways are UV and oxidative stress responses that trigger premature senescence, framed as the stress inputs that push cells into senescent growth arrest with a secretory (SASP) phenotype.

theme: tRNA and rRNA processing and modification
core_role: The shared pathways are nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA processing and the chemical modification of tRNA, rRNA and mRNA, framed as the RNA maturation required for accurate translation including aminoacylation and translational fidelity.

theme: Meiotic chromosome segregation and oocyte meiosis
core_role: The shared pathways are meiotic cohesion, chiasma formation, chromosome alignment, segregation and meiotic checkpoints, framed as the chromosome mechanics of meiosis, particularly female meiosis with spindle positioning and polar body extrusion.

theme: TGF-beta superfamily (TGF-beta, BMP, activin) signalling and regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are receptor and SMAD signalling of TGF-beta, BMP and activin with their positive and negative regulation and cancer mutants, framed as superfamily signalling whose ligands are also controlled extracellularly by sequestration.

theme: Renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure and fluid volume
core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin generation and signalling plus renal sodium and volume control, framed as systemic blood pressure and body fluid homeostasis that also involves thirst behaviour.

theme: IFN-gamma/IL-12-driven Th1 immunity and antigen presentation
core_role: The shared pathways are dendritic cell IL-12 production, IFN-gamma response and MHC upregulation driving Th1 responses, framed as type 1 cellular immunity linking antigen presentation to T cell activation.

theme: Cellular senescence induction and senescence-associated secretion
core_role: The shared pathways are oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, cell-cycle exit and the SASP, framed as the senescence program whose arrest is held by Polycomb-mediated chromatin silencing and cell-cycle transcriptional control.

theme: NAD+ metabolism and mitochondrial nucleotide transport
core_role: The shared pathways are NAD+/NADP+ synthesis, salvage and consumption plus mitochondrial ATP/ADP and NAD transport, framed as cellular redox-cofactor and energy-carrier homeostasis fed by de novo NAD+ synthesis from tryptophan via kynurenine.

theme: Endosomal recycling and Golgi membrane trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are endocytosis, endosome tubulation, receptor recycling and Golgi budding/secretion, framed as intracellular membrane trafficking that moves cargo between plasma membrane, endosomes and Golgi.

theme: Fertilization: sperm capacitation, motility and egg binding
core_role: The shared pathways are capacitation, zona pellucida binding and penetration, acrosome reaction and egg activation, framed as the sperm-egg interaction steps of fertilization that depend upon sperm flagellar motility.

theme: Notch signalling and regulated intramembrane proteolysis
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch receptor processing, nuclear signalling by NOTCH1-4 and its oncogenic mutants, plus related gamma-secretase cleavage events, framed as regulated intramembrane proteolysis signalling shared with p75NTR and ERBB4.

theme: Glial regulation of myelination and axon growth
core_role: The shared pathways are CNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte proliferation, gliosis and axon growth inhibition/stimulation, framed as glia-axon interactions governing myelination and axonal regeneration in CNS and PNS.

theme: Notch receptor signalling and its oncogenic dysregulation
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch intracellular-domain transcriptional signalling and its negative regulation and constitutive NOTCH1 mutants, framed as canonical Notch signalling that becomes oncogenic through NOTCH1 PEST/HD mutations and FBXW7 loss.

theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are NGF-TRKA activation and its downstream RAS/MAPK, ERK5, PI3K/AKT, PLC-gamma and CREB cascades, framed as the neurotrophin signalling program for neuronal survival and maturation shared with NTF3-NTRK3.

theme: Notch signalling to HES/HEY transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-HLH target transcription and its regulation, framed as the nuclear transcriptional output of Notch receptors such as NOTCH3 and NOTCH4.

theme: Cadherin-based adherens junction cell-cell adhesion
core_role: The shared pathways are calcium-dependent cell-cell adhesion and adherens junction assembly, framed as cadherin-mediated junctions whose cadherins are trafficked, degraded and cleaved.

theme: Eye development: lens, retina and anterior segment
core_role: The shared pathways cover morphogenesis of optic cup, retina, lens, cornea, iris and eyelid with lens transparency and retinal cell differentiation, framed as camera-type eye development including vascular regression and retinal programmed cell death.

theme: Cardiac conduction and action potential depolarization
core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte membrane depolarization and His-Purkinje conduction setting heart rate, framed as the electrical conduction system of the heart including repolarization and AV node activity.

theme: Glycolysis and cellular energy buffering
core_role: The shared pathways are glucose catabolism via hexokinase and fructose bisphosphate plus creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange, framed as cellular energy supply and buffering alongside oxygen transport.

theme: Glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are excitatory amino acid transporter-mediated glutamate/aspartate uptake and its disease variants, framed as neurotransmitter clearance and recycling alongside GABA synthesis, reuptake and vesicular loading.

theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain complex assembly
core_role: The shared pathways are complex III assembly and protein insertion into the inner mitochondrial membrane, framed as the biogenesis of OXPHOS complexes including complex I and ATP synthase assembly.

theme: T cell activation, signalling and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are TCR/IL-2/IL-7 signalling and ITK/PKC-mediated activation driving CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, framed as T cell activation leading to differentiation with costimulation.

theme: Actin cytoskeleton remodelling for cell shape and motility
core_role: The shared pathways are actin filament crosslinking, severing, capping and bundling with filopodium control and Rho/Eph signalling, framed as cytoskeletal dynamics that build protrusions like lamellipodia and pseudopodia for cell motility.

theme: p53 tumour suppressor regulation and DNA damage response
core_role: The shared pathways are p53 activation, degradation control and its checkpoint and apoptotic outputs, framed as tumour suppression by p53 whose upstream ARF defects allow escape from senescence and apoptosis.

theme: LDL receptor-mediated cholesterol uptake and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are LDL/VLDL receptor endocytosis, lysosomal degradation of the receptor and LXR-driven limitation of cholesterol uptake, framed as cellular sterol homeostasis by controlling cholesterol import.

theme: RAS-MAPK signalling and its oncogenic dysregulation
core_role: The shared pathways are RAS regulation by GAPs (including NF1) and oncogenic RAS/MAP2K mutants driving RSK activation, framed as RAS-MAPK pathway control downstream of receptor tyrosine kinases via SHC/SOS.

theme: HDL-mediated cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
core_role: The shared pathways are ApoA-I/LXR-driven cholesterol efflux and HDL handling that limit foam cell formation, framed as cellular sterol homeostasis by removing cholesterol from macrophages.

theme: Hormonal and nutrient-sensing control of fasting energy metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glucagon/PKA and AMPK signalling controlling gluconeogenesis, triglyceride synthesis and fatty acid homeostasis, framed as metabolic adaptation to fasting balanced against insulin and adiponectin signalling and lipolysis.

theme: DNA double-strand break response and repair
core_role: The shared pathways are DSB sensing by ATM, NHEJ and HR-versus-NHEJ regulation, framed as the DSB response that is compromised in BRCA1/BRCA2/BARD1 defects.

theme: B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are B cell signatures, germinal centre and Tfh differentiation and plasma cell generation, framed as humoral immunity in which B cells develop and differentiate into antibody-secreting cells.

theme: FGF receptor signalling and oncogenic FGFR mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are ligand activation and FRS/SHC/PI3K/PLC-gamma downstream signalling of FGFR1 and FGFR2 including activating mutants, framed as FGFR family signalling that extends to FGFR3.
